title: Udupi district to award tender for plastic waste processing facility
description: The Udupi district administration has invited bids for a 50 TPD plastic waste processing and recycling facility in Dakshina Kannada, with an expression of interest open to recyclers across Karnataka.

title: Udupi district to award tender for plastic waste processing facility - Deccan Herald
description: Udupi district administration invites bids for a plastic waste processing and recycling facility.

title: FMCG major commits to 30% recycled HDPE content in packaging by 2028
description: The company said it will procure recycled HDPE and PP granules from Indian recyclers and is opening vendor registration for suppliers in Maharashtra and Karnataka.

title: CPCB notifies amendment to Plastic Waste Management Rules tightening EPR targets
description: The Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change has issued a gazette notification amending the Plastic Waste Management Rules, raising extended producer responsibility recycled content obligations for brand owners.

title: Bengaluru startup raises Rs 120 crore to expand PET recycling capacity
description: The Karnataka-based recycler will use the investment to set up a new plant and add 30,000 tonnes per annum of rPET granule capacity.

title: Chemical recycling pilot using pyrolysis begins operations in Gujarat
description: The pilot plant will convert mixed plastic waste into pyrolysis oil, with equipment supplied by an Indian machinery maker specialising in extrusion and sorting lines.

title: Recycled PP granule prices firm up in western India on strong auto demand
description: Prices of recycled polypropylene granules rose Rs 3 per kg in Maharashtra as automotive component makers increased recycled content sourcing.

title: Mangaluru civic body signs waste-management contract for dry waste segregation
description: The Mangaluru city corporation awarded a contract covering dry waste collection and plastic scrap segregation across Dakshina Kannada wards.

title: Global plastics treaty talks resume in Geneva
description: Negotiators from India and other countries reconvene to discuss a global agreement on plastic pollution.
